explanation_full: Observationally, the SHAP analysis reveals a clear hierarchy of feature importance. ORP_Low exhibits the highest mean absolute SHAP value (0.0359), suggesting it is the primary driver of model predictions. This is followed by ORP_Mid (0.0314), Butyrate (0.0311), and VFA (0.0289). These features are significantly more influential than COD-O (0.0258) or Acetate (0.0257). Interpretation suggests that the redox potential (ORP) and key organic acids (Butyrate, VFA) are the most critical factors determining the outcome. However, this analysis is limited to the features included in the SHAP calculation, and other variables may also contribute to the model's performance.
